TypeI_row_pool_Y0_Y2.constraints: Weight-10 subset of the 60 cross-block edges with vertex-degree vector (2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2, 0,0,2,2) (or (2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2, 2,2,0,0)), 0 involution dominoes (KW_diag = 0), AND 0 edges with both endpoints outside the 8-vertex block I_B1 (enforced by M4 = E4 = F4 on the two Type-I blocks).

B4_4block_row_pools_Xr.note_on_previous_comment_terminology: In our 2026-11-03 comment, 91,392 was inadvertently described as the Type-I row pool; in fact, 22,176 is the Type-I row pool (gen_2block_rows((0,0,2,2), 0)), matching @ibenarb's 22,176 count and 289,536 compatible boundary states exactly, whereas 91,392 is the 4-block row pool X_r (gen_4block_rows) when row r in B_4 has a single zero in D_8[r] (degree multiset (0,1,1,2,2,2,2,2, 2,2,2,2) and KW_diag = 2).
